correctness.rationale: An explicit finite counterexample is supplied for each of 80 normalized strict cases and 76 normalized weak failures. Exhaustive enumeration of all 22 admissible source words of length at most four is exact. For the four weak survivors Kobayashi Theorem 4 conditions (a), (b1), (b2), (b3), (c) were checked directly, yielding preservation for every finite input; complement symmetry doubles the two normalized survivors at each length. Independent fraction-based finite-word exponent calculations cross-check the integer condition. The scope makes no infinite inference from finite enumeration without the theorem.
